holdout_status: NOT_RUN; unused seed, not independent physical evidence
range_assignment: Euclidean distance camera to 3D target source-row mean; half-open bins
task: 标出人形簇全部有效且投影落在画面内的源点的等权二维投影质心；每条源点计一次，包括投影重叠的源点；不是视觉外接框中点、不是三维均值再投影；排除家具和地面。网格和画面中心十字只辅助读像素，绝不指向目标。无人物时 u/v 均为 null。
truth_formula: mean_i(project(X_i)), finite source rows with depth>1e-9 and 0<=u<W,0<=v<H; no occlusion culling
v1_difference: v1 project(mean(X_i)) retained unchanged; metrics not directly comparable

score.px: Euclidean distance to mean projected source points
score.lateral_m: range_m * tan(angle(pick_ray, ray_through_truth_px)); diagnostic proxy only
score.range_reference: range to 3D source-row mean, not physical range GT

usage.per_bin: n_person/n_tp and px/lateral min,p50,p95,max; FN/FP separately
usage.empty_bin: null statistics; no interpolation or pooled replacement
usage.v1_30cm: observed maximum rounded from 12 development synthetic samples; not an upper bound
usage.transfer: no transfer across protocols, prompts, camera, renderer, source sampling or annotators

order: oracle and injected-contract tests explicitly nonblind
model blind selfcheck, holdout, cross-model and real sessions NOT_RUN
dependencies: v1 module retained and hashed together with v2 source and this protocol
